name: Photo Doctor ALMAZ training contract
rules: Smoke datasets validate code only and MUST NOT produce release checkpoints.
Training and exam splits are separated by original source image/group, never by crop.
User D/N/U feedback is hard-mining/preference data, not expert ground truth.
Near-monochrome and sepia photos must not acquire new local chroma islands.
Faces must prefer slightly softer output over invented identity details.
No release model may be selected only by PSNR/SSIM. Safety gate is mandatory.
All downloaded sources must record origin URL, license, checksum when available, and source group id.
